name: Cleanup After Trim Paint
intent: Final inspect cured trim, touch up any final defects, tear down floor protection and wall masking, clean tools. Final inspect is the most critical step because trim is high-visibility.
doctrine: Several rates here are gap-filled (final inspect, final touchup, clean tools fixed time). The protection teardown rate (500 SF/hr) is from the source spec — slower than trim prime teardown (1500 SF/hr) for the same reason setup is slower: the painter is working around finished surfaces.
